notes.title: SITREP #006 - Echoes Below Development Update
notes.notes: [h2]Hey Operators![/h2][p]We’ve got [b]big news[/b] we can finally share with you! To keep things short and informative, we're splitting this announcement into multiple parts, and we’ll reveal more of what we’ve worked on incrementally as the Early Access launch gets closer.[/p][p]To kick off this series of announcements, we thought it would be cool to include one of the most impactful changes to the game. Over the past few weeks, we’ve pushed ourselves to the limit once again – and now, we’re thrilled to announce:[/p][p][/p][h3][b][u]Echoes Below will launch into Early Access with full Coop support from day one![/u][/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The full integration still needs a bit of polish, which is why we can’t give you an exact release date just yet. But we’re doing everything we can to keep the wait as short as possible – and of course, we’ll keep you posted![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529128/6c129c78678f331dca29cd29d1113012fad43809.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You’ll be able to choose whether to explore the archipelago and face its challenges solo or together with up to [b]4 players[/b] in cooperative mode.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]At the same time, we’ve reworked the base-building system and added an optional [b]modular building mode[/b], giving you more freedom to shape your base the way you want it.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529128/fe862bebacd051830e498b861f3f322c34570c31.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]All three building tiers now feature additional [b]modular structures[/b] that can be mixed and matched however you like. We’ll continue to add even more modular building pieces, decorative items, and full structures over time.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]And last but not least, we’re happy to introduce a brand-new customization feature![/b][/p][p][/p][p]To give you a first impression of the new customization options, we're excited to showcase the brand new country flag patches. These patches can be worn by players on their equipment and clothing - for example on helmets, uniforms or plate carriers and chest rigs. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529128/fc7358ed8e8fecbbbdd32eb41ac3ba097a3bbd6b.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529128/e3e6ff3b7310e019db2c7ac664a1371e8bd92039.png"][/img][/p][p]This is just the first batch of country patches, if you'd like to suggest a country flag that's not on the list yet, feel free to hop on our discord server and post your suggestion![/p][p]Here's the full list of currently included flag patches: [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529128/821ae5aa0c19bfde6c7dd8de2e2238dc1bad5923.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As mentioned in our previous update, the awesome folks at [url="https://calibercollective.org/"]Caliber Collective[/url] are helping us stress-test Echoes Below – and we’re [b]incredibly grateful[/b] for their support. To show our appreciation, we’re introducing their [b]unit patch[/b] as an in-game customization option![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529128/a5f04a206c6317885792a327c8d02fbbcd4095ae.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ll also be adding more patch designs in the future, so you can personalize your character even further.[/p][p]Several features originally planned for post-launch updates have been moved up and are already being worked on – you’ll see these reflected in our updated [b]roadmap[/b] on the store page soon to give you a clearer overview.[/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Thank you for your patience and continued support – we’re beyond excited to hear what you think![/i][/b][/p][p][b][i]Have a fantastic week,[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]– Echo Division-[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: SITREP #005 – Echoes Below Community Briefing
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Hey Operators[/b][/h2]

Today we want to reach out to you about something that means a lot to us.

It is with a [b]heavy heart[/b] that we’ve decided not to participate in the upcoming Next Fest. The planned demo and the associated workload have simply become too much for us to manage right now. As a two-person team, it’s up to us to constantly evaluate and prioritize where we put our focus and energy. Taking part in the event—and meeting all the content, scope, and presentation requirements—would have forced us to reduce the demo to its bare essentials, scrapping most of the ideas we had originally planned. Honestly, that just didn’t sit right with us or match our vision.

[b]Echoes Below[/b] is a pretty ambitious project—and we intend to keep it that way. Trying to compress everything into a thirty-minute demo just wasn’t possible without leaving out essential parts of the experience, and that’s something we couldn’t accept.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529128/f8657bb2ea14fa0fce8b4e2d52603ac62cbd7a2b.png[/img]
On top of all this, we’re also working flat out on the main game, which is where our true focus lies. For the sake of our own health as well, this was an absolutely important and necessary decision that we had to make together, right away. Our idea is to put the time we’ve gained into building out crucial features and mechanics, so we can offer you the best possible gameplay experience without compromising further.
But we’re not only using this time for that—we’re already actively working on something that, let’s just say, will have a huge impact on the game. We’ll share all the details in our next announcement, along with more insights on our current progress.
We hope - and we’re confident - it will be a worthy compensation for you!

[b][i]Thank you for your understanding and your time. It was important for us to be as transparent and honest with you as possible.[/i][/b]


[b]There’s one more thing we’d like to share[/b]:

For some time now, we’ve been collaborating with the members of [b]Caliber Collective[/b] (CC). Through their [b]playtest program[/b]  [url=https://calibercollective.org/#playtesting]Click here![/url]  they’ll be putting [b]Echoes Below[/b] through its paces, helping us get vital insights on performance, bugs, and more, so we can keep improving. We’re extremely grateful for this opportunity and look forward to everything that lies ahead!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529128/673d30d1698dd8f235f38bfc15619f816ae64e2c.gif[/img]

So a big, official [i][b]thank you[/b][/i] from us for all the support and the transparent, enriching collaboration!
If you’re interested, [b]check them out[/b]—it’s definitely worth it! [url=https://calibercollective.org/]Click here![/url]
And if you want to connect or find great content, especially in the tactical shooter space, we can highly recommend their [b]Discord[/b] server! [url=https://discord.gg/4Ynp9g778t]Click here![/url] You’ll find all the links to their social media platforms on the [b]CC[/b] homepage as well.

[b][i]Wishing you all the best![/i]

[i]—Echo Division—[/i][/b]

notes.title: SITREP #003 - Echoes Below Development Update
notes.notes:
[h2][b]FPS Gameplay Overhaul & Immersion Improvements[/b][/h2]


[b]Hey Operators![/b]

We’re thrilled to share our latest update focused entirely on enhancing your [b]FPS gameplay[/b] experience! From realistic gun handling and immersive camera effects to dynamic audio improvements, we've got a lot to cover. Let’s dive into the key highlights:


[b]1. FPS Gameplay[/b]

We've worked hard on improving the general FPS gameplay, how guns are handled, and even smaller details like movement and foley SFX. We've recorded a before-and-after showcase, highlighting improvements such as realistic upper body movement during walking and running, dynamic idle states, and newly introduced lowready and highready stances. Highready helps prevent weapon obstruction (especially with long rifles) in close-quarters environments, while lowready slightly increases movement speed while keeping your weapon ready. We've refined our motion-captured animations, adding manual adjustments, procedural limb physics, and subtle micro-animations, such as the MP5’s charging handle. Foley SFX for reloads enhance realism, and leaning around corners is now smoother. Customization has proper audio feedback for individual attachments, with further improvements [b]coming soon[/b].


[list]
[*]Realistic upper body movement and idle animations
[/list][list]
[*]New Lowready and Highready stances
[/list][list]
[*]Refined motion-captured animations with procedural physics
[/list][list]
[*]Micro-animations for weapon parts
[/list][list]
[*]Improved leaning mechanics
[/list][list]
[*]Attachment-specific audio feedback
[/list]


[previewyoutube=wwB2JNA2zBw;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]2. Dynamic Aim Offset and Improved Optics[/b]

This improvement introduces dynamic aim offsets, automatically adjusting camera views in ADS when switching between iron sights and scopes. A slight weapon sway enhances realism during ADS. Scope sight pictures have also been improved, and previous performance issues with magnified optics have now been resolved.


[list]
[*]Dynamic aim offset adjustments
[/list][list]
[*]Weapon sway during ADS
[/list][list]
[*]Improved optics and performance optimization
[/list]


[previewyoutube=kBZDtfQ_fFk;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]3. Dynamic 3D Audio Zones[/b]

To enhance [b]immersion[/b], we’ve introduced dynamic 3D audio zones for both outdoor and various indoor environments such as hangars, warehouses, houses, and bunkers, each with thematic ambient SFX. Zones smoothly transition between audio tracks with gentle fades. Additionally, flat projected audio zones cover large water bodies like oceans, increasing wave sounds as you approach the coast and fading out as you move away. Weather effects are also restricted from indoor areas—no more rain or snow inside buildings! Improvements to our footstep audio system are underway and will be featured in future updates.


[list]
[*]Smooth audio transitions between zones
[/list][list]
[*]Specialized audio for oceans and indoor areas
[/list][list]
[*]Weather effects restricted indoors
[/list][list]
[*]Upcoming footstep audio improvements
[/list]


[previewyoutube=XdiPHX0euLQ;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]4. Loot Interaction Animations & SFX[/b]

Looting now feels more immersive, thanks to animated props complemented by dedicated sound effects.


[list]
[*]Animated loot props
[/list][list]
[*]Dedicated loot interaction sounds
[/list]


[previewyoutube=smVJXvscZGE;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]5. Muzzle Flash Shadows[/b]

We’ve replaced our previous muzzle flash placeholder with a new [b]VFX[/b]. In dark environments or nighttime scenarios, muzzle flashes now cast dynamic shadows. We've significantly reduced and fine-tuned distortion effects, making precise aiming easier, particularly during burst and full-auto fire modes.


[list]
[*]New muzzle flash VFX with dynamic shadows
[/list][list]
[*]Reduced and fine-tuned distortion effects
[/list]


[previewyoutube=LW-B0qR_0HQ;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]6. Vaulting, Climbing & Sliding[/b]

Players now have many more traversal options, including vaulting barriers, climbing taller obstacles, and sliding under certain objects while sprinting. We're actively experimenting with further movement improvements and will likely showcase additional mechanics, such as rope climbing, soon.


[list]
[*]New vaulting, climbing, and sliding mechanics
[/list][list]
[*]Future traversal improvements in testing
[/list]


[previewyoutube=PiF4ru23GWs;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]7. Weapon Sway[/b]

Weapon sway has been refined to reflect the weight of each weapon, enhancing gun handling and [b]realism[/b], and emphasizing slower, more tactical movements rather than rushing enemy positions.


[list]
[*]Weight-based weapon sway
[/list][list]
[*]Encourages tactical movement
[/list]


[previewyoutube=eS3ju_tNKts;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]8. Weather FX[/b]

[b]New camera effects[/b] have been introduced for weather conditions and environmental interactions. During winter, frost accumulates on the camera lens and melts as spring arrives, while raindrops appear on the lens during rainfall. Additionally, diving and resurfacing cause water runoff effects on the camera lens—players will need a moment for vision to normalize, so caution is advised when surfacing near enemy patrols.


[list]
[*]Seasonal frost effects
[/list][list]
[*]Dynamic rain droplets on the lens
[/list][list]
[*]Water runoff effects when surfacing from underwater
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529128/840cacb3042b5739229c2f2d9b89bf46c8848195.gif[/img]


[previewyoutube=JuGKnUeFBSE;full][/previewyoutube]


[i][b]Additional Improvements & Sneak Peek[/b][/i]

[i]We're continually expanding the [b]Echoes Below[/b] arsenal—check out the GIF [b]below[/b] for a sneak peek at some of the current weapon options. Even more will follow soon!

Alongside these updates, we've refined other aspects of our sound design, including ambient sounds and interactive audio. The UI redesign has greatly improved and will be finalized shortly.

[b]Stay tuned[/b]—our next update will delve deeper into factions, lore, and additional exciting enhancements.

[b]Thanks for your ongoing support! Let us know your feedback in the comments![/b][/i]


-Echo Division-


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529128/f889cc7c9dc18f3c9e569cba970f3d519ffa7655.gif[/img]

notes.title: Recon Ops #002 - Conclusion
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Hey everyone![/b][/h3]

First off, a huge thank you for your participation in our recent content poll — your feedback means the world to us.
We’re currently working full throttle to provide more development insights and keep you fully updated.

We’re just as hyped as you are, and can’t wait to show you more of what’s coming!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529128/4f764eae815aa018f0c00bfb462ba768be6ebf15.jpg[/img]



[b]🔧 What’s Next?[/b]

Starting this weekend, we’ll begin posting regular dev updates every weekend — with behind-the-scenes content, development progress, and deeper looks into key systems.

If you’d like to be more directly involved, feel free to join our [b]Discord[/b] and become part of the journey — we’re always open to your ideas, suggestions, and feedback.


[b]💢 Focus Area: Gunplay Polish[/b]

Right now, our main focus is refining the gunplay and weapon handling. We’ll soon be sharing short video clips to give you a better feel for how it plays — aiming to make every shot feel responsive, punchy, and immersive.


[b]💥 Sneak Peek: Factions Incoming[/b]

In the near future, we’ll also begin revealing the first details about the factions you’ll encounter in Echoes Below.
They’re a big part of the game world — both in terms of lore and gameplay — and we can’t wait to hear your thoughts.



[b]Thanks again for your support — let’s build this together! [/b]


-Echo Division-

notes.title: SITREP #002 - Echoes Below Community Briefing
notes.notes:
[h3][b]ROADMAP 2025[/b][/h3]

[h2]Survival Expansion Update[/h2]

[list]
[*]Introducing Modular Building System (Foundations, Floors, Walls, Ceilings/Roofs, Pillars, and more)
[/list][list]
[*]Various building materials for the modular pieces, like logs/stone for the bivouac stage, metal/plywood for the FOB stage, and concrete/steel for the TOC stage
[/list][list]
[*]New buildable structures for the bivouac stage
[/list][list]
[*]Fishing![/list][list]
[*]New tool item: fishing rod
[/list][list]
[*]Introducing new status effects like sickness when exposed to cold temperatures without proper clothing or by eating raw food
[/list][list]
[*]New deployable item: portable heater
[/list][list]
[*]New cooking recipes
[/list][list]
[*]New deployable traps (can be used for hunting or defense)
[/list][list]
[*]New clothing items
[/list][list]
[*]New decorative items/structures for the bivouac stage
[/list][list]
[*]Introducing camouflage system: clothing items will have camouflage stats which can decrease the chances of being spotted
[/list][list]
[*]Introducing Weapon Paint Jobs: enables players to spray various paint jobs on their weapons (e.g. woodland, desert, mountain, urban, etc.); paint jobs automatically apply to equipped attachments as well
[/list][list]
[*]Weapon paint jobs can increase camo stats
[/list][list]
[*]And much more, but we don't want to spoil too much!
[/list]


[h2]Vehicle Warfare Update[/h2]

[list]
[*]Introducing enemy vehicles
[/list][list]
[*]Introducing enemy motorized patrols (both land & sea)
[/list][list]
[*]New driveable vehicles (air, land, and sea); some will also feature combat capabilities
[/list][list]
[*]Vehicle Paint Jobs can be applied via the Vehicle Workshop building, unlockable in FOB and TOC building stages
[/list][list]
[*]Vehicle customization: new mountable weapon systems, headlights, storage upgrades, etc.
[/list][list]
[*]Introducing MLRS, which can be used in combination with the UAV drone target system
[/list][list]
[*]New UAV drone abilities, like MLRS shelling, air strikes, and special mortar rounds
[/list][list]
[*]Unlockable supply airdrop (will be unlocked during mission/story progression)
[/list][list]
[*]New squadmate class: combat engineer (can place or defuse mines, repair vehicles)
[/list][list]
[*]And much more!
[/list]


[h2]Animation Overhaul / Improvements Update[/h2]

[list]
[*]Introducing various new motion-captured animations, linked to both existing and new interactions
[/list][list]
[*]Improvements to existing animations and/or full replacements with newly mocapped data
[/list][list]
[*]Various new animations for NPCs
[/list][list]
[*]Refinements to existing facial mocaps as well as introducing new facial animations for NPCs
[/list][list]
[*]Major friendly & enemy AI improvements, tweaks, and general overhaul (this will also be based on player feedback)
[/list][list]
[*]New clothing variations for both enemy and friendly NPCs
[/list][list]
[*]Introducing Ballistic Shield item (can only be used in combination with sidearms like pistols or compact SMGs such as the P320 or MP5K); semi-auto or burst fire is highly recommended — unless you really want to use a "to whom it may concern" approach with compact SMGs in full-auto fire modes
[/list][list]
[*]New defensive structures for the TOC building stage
[/list][list]
[*]And much more, but you know the drill — we don't like to spoil too much!
[/list]


[h2]Additional POIs (Points of Interest)[/h2]

[list]
[*]We keep those entirely secret — sorry folks!
[/list]


[h2]Map Expansion Update[/h2]

[list]
[*]It... well, expands the map! But as mentioned above, no spoilers here! Let's just say you might want to grab some water-tight combat boots from your inventory for this one!
[/list]

[h2]Base and Home Decorations[/h2]

[list]
[*]Introducing a TON of new decorative items/structures for ALL building stages
[/list][list]
[*]Features both interactable/functional decorations as well as decorative-only ones
[/list][list]
[*]There's more planned besides decorations, but again... no spoilers, sorry!
[/list]

[h2]Coop Multiplayer[/h2]

[list]
[*]Yeah, you've waited for this one, huh? Introducing Coop Multiplayer (play with your friends!)
[/list][list]
[*]Friendly fire can be turned off in the settings
[/list][list]
[*]Introducing per-player squads, so each player can lead a fireteam (this is still experimental and we need to balance things properly — but we'll keep you guys updated on this)
[/list][list]
[*]Still in development, so we can't tell you too much about it other than what the title already suggests — but let's just say that coop mode is not just a way to play with friends... it WILL have an impact on the storyline as well.
[/list]


[i][b]Some features are still TBD and experimental, others might even make it earlier into the game. We'll keep you updated![/b][/i]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529128/39964795a743cf377beaba0f8843ecf38aef2f1c.jpg[/img]

Our journey has just begun, and we can’t wait to share this experience with you as we move towards Early Access!

[/list][list]
